visual_identity.core_identity: A normal-looking weapon animated by magic, flying and attacking with no hand, arm, or visible wielder.
visual_identity.silhouette: Single sword suspended horizontally or diagonally in open air with a clear motion arc.
visual_identity.body_shape: One complete sword with blade, guard, grip, and pommel; the weapon itself is the creature.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No limbs whatsoever; movement comes from magical levitation of the complete sword.
visual_identity.surface: Clean metal blade and simple hilt with minimal decorative marks.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Suspended by magical force with one clear attack or guard orientation and no visible support.

accuracy_checks: exactly one sword is shown as the creature

known_failure_modes.symptom: hand, ghost, or warrior appears holding sword
known_failure_modes.correction: remove wielder entirely; the sword itself is animated
